lattices.label: Body-centered cubic (bcc)
lattices.description: Body-centered cubic; two species give an interpenetrating simple cubic (CsCl) lattice.

lattices.label: Cesium chloride (CsCl)
lattices.description: Interpenetrating simple cubic lattices (alias of bcc).

lattices.label: Face-centered cubic (fcc)
lattices.description: Face-centered cubic; two species create a random alloy.

lattices.label: Diamond
lattices.description: Diamond cubic; two species give a zincblende lattice.

lattices.label: Zincblende (zb)
lattices.description: Zincblende cubic; a single species gives diamond.

lattices.label: Graphite
lattices.description: Graphite lattice (also hexagonal boron nitride with two species).

lattices.label: Nanotube (NT)
lattices.description: Nanotube along Z; a0 is the first-neighbour distance, (m,n) the chiral indices.

options.label: Add atom at position
options.description: Add an atom of the given species at a position.

options.label: Add atom relative to atom
options.description: Add an atom at a vector relative to an existing atom.

options.description: Add an atom in the tetrahedral site next to an existing atom.

options.description: Add N atoms at random positions.

options.label: Add shells
options.description: Create core-shell model shells for a species (or all).

options.description: Rotate so the first cell vector is along X and the second lies in the XY plane.

options.label: Bind shells
options.description: Re-associate shells with their cores (core-shell model).

options.label: Modify cell
options.description: Add to, remove from or set a cell length, angle or component.

options.description: Move all atoms so the given atom (or the center of mass) is at the box center.

options.label: Duplicate

options.label: Freeze atoms (all)

options.label: Freeze atoms (above/below plane)

options.label: Properties from file
options.description: Define system or per-atom properties from a text file.

options.label: Rebox
options.description: Recompute a rectangular bounding box (inaccurate; check the result).

options.label: Reduce cell
options.description: Shorten the cell while preserving periodicity (x, y, z, or p for primitive cell; none for all directions).

options.label: Remove atom by index

options.label: Remove atoms by species

options.label: Remove selected atoms

options.description: Remove an auxiliary property (or 'all').

options.label: Remove shells
options.description: Remove shells for a species (or all).

options.description: Rotate the system around x, y or z.

options.description: Reduce box tilt by adding or subtracting box vectors.

options.label: Velocity
options.description: Assign Maxwell-Boltzmann velocities at temperature T.

options.label: Wrap
options.description: Put atoms back in the box using periodic boundary conditions.

modes.label: Merge
modes.description: Merge several systems into one. By default every atom is put in the first file's box; with a direction the systems are stacked along x, y or z. Options are applied after the merge.

args.name: direction
args.label: Stack direction (optional; omit to merge into the first file's box)

args.name: files
args.label: Files to merge (one path per line, at least 2)

modes.label: Average
modes.description: Average atom positions, cell vectors and auxiliary properties over a list of snapshots. Options are applied to the averaged system.

args.name: files
args.label: Snapshots to average (one path per line)

modes.label: Gather snapshots
modes.description: Read several snapshots and write them into one multi-configuration file (animated XSF or XYZ). Options are applied to each snapshot.

args.name: files
args.label: Snapshots to gather (one path per line)

modes.label: Convert file list
modes.description: Convert every file named in the list. Output files keep their names and are written next to each input file.

args.name: files
args.label: Files to convert (one path per line)

modes.label: Copy properties
modes.description: Copy auxiliary properties from the first file into the second one. The output keeps the positions and properties of the second file.

modes.label: ddplot visualization
modes.description: Build a ddplot file from an ideal system and a dislocated system with the same number of atoms. The output format is always dd.

modes.label: Interpolate configurations
modes.description: Build a chain of configurations by linearly interpolating atom positions and cell vectors between two systems. Outputs are named <prefix>_img0, <prefix>_img1, ...

modes.label: Match atom IDs
modes.description: Sort atoms of the second file into the same order as the atoms of the first file, keeping shells and auxiliary properties.

modes.label: Polycrystal
modes.description: Build a Voronoi polycrystal from a seed system and a parameter file. Grain positions and orientations can be random, on a lattice, or written node by node.

modes.label: Unfold snapshots
modes.description: Split a multi-configuration file (HISTORY, LAMMPS dump, PWscf output, OUTCAR, animated XSF or XYZ) into one file per snapshot. Outputs are named <prefix>1, <prefix>2, ...

modes.label: Unwrap coordinates
modes.description: Unwrap atom coordinates of the second file using the first file as the reference, undoing periodic boundary wrapping.

modes.label: Difference
modes.description: Compute displacement vectors and statistics between two configurations. Writes several files prefixed with the second file's name into the chosen output folder.

modes.label: Density
modes.description: Compute the 1D, 2D or 3D density of a property on a Gaussian grid. Writes the data (and, for 3D, interstitial/vacancy files) into the chosen output folder.

args.name: property
args.label: Property (mass, a species, or an auxiliary property)

modes.label: Radial distribution function
modes.description: Compute the radial distribution function(s) up to a maximum radius. Writes the data files into the chosen output folder.

modes.label: Local symmetry
modes.description: Compute the local symmetry (centrosymmetry) parameter of each atom and write it as an auxiliary property. Options are applied before the calculation.

modes.label: Nye tensor
modes.description: Compute per-atom strain, rotation and Nye tensors from a reference system and the system to analyse. The reference may be a full system, a unit cell, or NULL.

args.name: reference
args.label: Reference file, a unit cell, or NULL

modes.label: Electric dipole moments
modes.description: Compute individual electric dipole moments of polyhedra. Charges must be set in the input file or with the properties option. Writes several files into the chosen output folder.

args.name: species
args.label: Species at the corners of the polyhedra

args.name: nnn
args.label: Neighbour count (positive) or cutoff radius (negative, Å); 0 for automatic

modes.label: Electronic polarization
modes.description: Compute the electronic polarization of each ion in a core-shell model. Charges and shells must be present in the input. Writes files into the chosen output folder.

args.name: file
args.label: Structure file with cores and shells

modes.label: Help
modes.description: Print the Atomsk help, optionally for one topic. The output is shown in the log; no structure file is written.
